newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank Canada sets 2nd round of specials.
newsitem.headline: Bank Canada sets 2nd round of specials.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Thursday conducted a second round of special purchase and resale agreements in the money market at 3.25 percent, traders said.
The Bank of Canada intervened as the call loan or overnight lending rate continued to trade at the top of the central bank's 2.75-3.25 percent target range, dealers said.
"There was a second round at 3.25 just for the dislocations. Now it's getting hit at 3.10 so I think somebody has found some cash," said one Toronto-based trader.
The call loan rate last traded at 3.10 percent. The three-month cash T-bill traded with a yield of 2.76 percent.
